g.text: Fleet — Mission lifecycle: four stages, the mission's states, and the boards it lives on

text.tspan: (draw out intent, pick the squad, write the mission)

Stages run in order and never merge or reorder. 'active' covers ready/in-progress/paused; on PR-merge the mission crosses to 'completed' and winds down through cleanup then post-mortem, then retires off every board.
Parked is active-but-held: troops in position, deliberately waiting on a trigger.
